goal: Move a UOR Foundation project through Sandbox, Incubation, Graduated and Archived only by an act of the Technical Oversight Committee on complete evidence.

app.name: uor-toc-lifecycle
app.title: TOC project lifecycle
app.purpose: Give the next lifecycle stage of a UOR Foundation project from its stage now, the application before the TOC, whether a quorum met, the TOC's recorded vote, whether the stage's evidence is complete and how many days the public comment period ran.

fields.name: stage
fields.means: the project's lifecycle stage now; proposed is a project not yet admitted

fields.name: application
fields.means: the stage change the issue in UOR-Foundation/.github asks for

fields.name: quorum
fields.means: whether a majority of the whole committee was present (Bylaws 6.5)

fields.name: vote
fields.means: the TOC's recorded act: no vote yet, rejected, carried by a majority of members present, or carried by at least two thirds

fields.name: evidence
fields.means: whether the application carries every evidence item toc/README.md lists for that stage

fields.name: comment
fields.means: days the public comment period ran before the vote

meanings.proposed: not admitted: no TOC act has admitted the project to Sandbox
meanings.sandbox: early fit and potential, admitted by TOC approval
meanings.incubation: increasing maturity, admitted by a simple-majority TOC vote
meanings.graduated: production readiness, admitted by a two-thirds TOC vote after a public comment period of at least 14 days
meanings.archived: inactive, superseded or no longer recommended, the final stage

rules.why: toc/README.md: Archived is the stage of inactive, superseded or no longer recommended projects; GOVERNANCE.md 11: an archived repository is a read-only historical state

toc/README.md: Sandbox needs a clear use case, an active maintainer and the README.md, LICENSE and CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md baseline, by TOC approval; Bylaws 6.5: the act of a majority of members present at a quorum is the act of the committee

toc/README.md: Incubation needs ongoing maintenance and contributor activity, CONTRIBUTING.md and maintainership clarity, versioned releases or APIs and at least one adopter, by TOC vote (simple majority)

toc/README.md: Graduation needs multi-organization maintainership, security posture, proven adoption and release and review discipline, by TOC vote (2/3), after a public comment period of at least 2 weeks
toc/README.md: Archived on sustained inactivity, maintainer request or supersession, by TOC vote (simple majority)
toc/README.md: a project stays at its stage until a TOC decision moves it
toc/README.md: a project stays at its stage until a TOC decision moves it
toc/README.md: a project stays at its stage until a TOC decision moves it

app.otherwiseWhy: toc/README.md: projects usually enter at Sandbox; until the TOC admits one it is only proposed

properties.why: Bylaws 6.5: without a quorum there is no act of the committee
toc/README.md: Graduation takes two thirds, not a simple majority
toc/README.md: Graduation requires a public comment period of at least 2 weeks before voting
toc/README.md: projects enter at Sandbox; no stage is skipped
toc/README.md: Graduation is applied for from Incubation
toc/README.md: the minimum repository baseline is required for Sandbox
toc/README.md: a graduated project leaves its stage only by archival

stakeholders.name: Project applicant
stakeholders.text: Opens a Sandbox, Incubation or Graduation issue in UOR-Foundation/.github and needs to know which evidence and which vote move the project.

stakeholders.name: TOC member
stakeholders.text: Votes on applications and needs no transition to happen without a quorum, the required majority and complete evidence.

stakeholders.name: Community and Outreach Committee
stakeholders.text: Publishes each project's stage to the community and needs the published stage to be the one the TOC's acts determine.

components.name: TOC application issues
components.text: The Sandbox, Incubation and Graduation issues in UOR-Foundation/.github that carry each application and its evidence.

components.name: TOC minutes
components.text: The committee's recorded acts (Bylaws 6.3), which give quorum and vote.

threats.name: Stage skipped
threats.text: A proposed or Sandbox project is published as Incubation or Graduated without passing each stage.

control.name: One stage per act
control.text: Each rule fires only from the stage below the one it admits.

threats.name: Graduation without comment
threats.text: A Graduation vote is held before the community could comment.

control.name: Comment period floor
control.text: Graduation needs a comment period of at least 14 days.

threats.name: Vote miscounted
threats.text: The tally of members present is recorded wrongly before it reaches the app.
threats.accepted: The app is given the committee's recorded act; counting members present and keeping minutes belongs to the TOC chair under Bylaws 6.3 and 6.5.

quality.text: Each Decision row of the toc/README.md stage table is one rule of the machine.
quality.measureText: Stage table rows with no rule.

quality.requirement: Every move is a committee act
quality.text: No transition fires without a quorum and a carried vote.
quality.measureText: Rules that change the stage without quorum met and a carried vote.
